symbols.name: coordinate index
symbols.meaning: An integer from 1 to d that names one coordinate of the array.
symbols.quote: Let $\sigma$ name one coordinate, running from $1$ to $d$.

symbols.name: cyclic length
symbols.meaning: The number of positions along coordinate sigma before its indices wrap around.
symbols.quote: Let $n_\sigma$ be the cyclic length of coordinate $\sigma$, the number of positions along that axis before indices wrap around.

symbols.name: shortened-coordinate count
symbols.meaning: The number of coordinates whose length is r/2 in the padded box.
symbols.quote: Let $\varkappa$ be the number of coordinates of length $r/2$.

symbols.name: box size
symbols.meaning: The number of entries of the padded box, a power of two; on this page only, not the three-element subsets of other pages.
symbols.quote: The box holds $T$ entries, the box size, a power of two ($T$ here, not the three-element subsets of other pages).

symbols.name: twist position
symbols.meaning: An integer position from 0 to r-1 on the last coordinate, at which the phase twist acts.
symbols.quote: Let $\upsilon$ be a position on the last axis, an integer from $0$ to $r-1$.

symbols.name: second position
symbols.meaning: A second position on the last coordinate, paired with upsilon in a sum.
symbols.quote: Let $\upsilon'$ be a second such position.

symbols.name: reduced position
symbols.meaning: The position in the range from 0 to r-1 that equals the sum of upsilon and upsilon' minus r when the sum wraps.
symbols.quote: If $\upsilon+\upsilon'\ge r$, let $\upsilon''$ be the reduced position, so $\upsilon+\upsilon'=\upsilon''+r$ with $0\le\upsilon''<r$.

relations.quote: A cyclic coordinate is one axis of a multidimensional [cyclic convolution](cyclic-convolution.md), with its own cyclic length.
The lengths are set by the [padded transform box](padded-transform-box.md) of the paper's Section 9.2.1, where each length is $r/2$ or $r$.
